name: Silviana
source:
The pet dog of Risa. Initially the pet of a cruel breeder, she is rescued by Risa and Yuuichi. She is quiet and shy throughout the game, partially due to her relatively low intelligence.
 She is part of a rare and valuable breed of dog, and thus it was necessary for Yuuichi to spend a lot of money to free her.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wanko_to_Kurasō]Wikipedia[/url]]

Her breed is a golden shih tzu.
